evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative command directed at an audience, enacting hierarchy through a directive to purge knowledge.
Second imperative command reinforcing the same directive stance — authority enacted through an order to erase records.
Assertive closure that ratifies the preceding directives by declaring the counter-fact, performing authority through definitive pronouncement.

mints.name: DirectiveErasureCommand
mints.title: command to forget and remove knowledge entirely
mints.frame: Is the speaker enacting authority by ordering the erasure of shared knowledge, and does the assertion that follows ratify that erasure?
